item_name: Missing Documentation of Tuberculosis Test or Follow-Up
lookback_notes: The protocol states a TB test is required prior to patient contact and that documentation of a yearly tuberculosis test, screening questionnaire, risk assessment, or required follow-up must be in the personnel file, but it does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days for this audit area. The only day-count windows in the document appear in unrelated areas (e.g. Area 30's 7-day PRI look back on p. 18).

federal_coding_rules.rule: If documentation of a yearly tuberculosis test, screening questionnaire, risk assessment, or the required follow-up to a positive test result is not in the personnel file of the aide who had direct patient contact, the claim will be disallowed.

state_deltas.delta: This OMIG audit protocol is itself a New York State document; Area 21 disallows claims where TB test/screening/follow-up documentation is missing from the aide's personnel file, citing NY regulations 10 NYCRR § 763.13(c)(4), 10 NYCRR § 766.11(d)(4), 10 NYCRR § 763.13(e) and (h), 18 NYCRR § 487.9(a)(8)(ii), 18 NYCRR § 488.9(a)(5)(ii), and 18 NYCRR § 494.3(b).

For services 12/16/20 and after, additional NYS DOH guidance applies: DAL DHCBS 21-05 (TB Testing Clarification), DAL DHCBS 21-03 (FAQs Regarding Annual TB Testing), and DAL DHCBS 20-14 (Annual TB Testing).
